title: Stationary backward sweep state change
statement: Let $A$ be a symbol alphabet, $S$ a state set, and $x$ a finite word over $A$. For optional states $q,q'$, an input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ valid positions, an integer frontier $z$, finite lists $l,r$ of possibly blank symbols from $A$, and an output word $out$, applying the action that leaves the input head stationary, makes no change to the work tape or its head position, emits no output, and sets the successor state to $q'$ to the backward-sweep configuration determined by $q,p,z,l,r,out$ gives the backward-sweep configuration with the same $p,z,l,r,out$ and state $q'$.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol alphabet A and state set S
A finite input word x over A
An input-head position among the |x|+2 valid positions
Finite lists l and r of possibly blank symbols
replaced:
Applying a stationary phase-change action — no write, no head movement, no output — to a
backward-facing zipper configuration replaces only the control state and leaves the
tape, input head, and output unchanged.
